responsibility: Exercises the markdown parser’s tokenization and normalization behavior, validating how markdown source is converted into `MdTree` streams across inline formatting, code spans and blocks, headings, links and reference links, list parsing, whitespace/newline handling, and paragraph-break insertion.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `markdown/parse.rs`, which implements markdown parsing and normalization, this file is only the parser test suite: it invokes helpers such as `parse_simple_pat`, `parse_heading`, and `entrypoint` to verify the produced `MdTree` structure for many markdown forms.
